verdict.rationale: Missive documents and a live probe confirm a hosted MCP server (mcp.missiveapp.com) letting external AI apps like Claude/ChatGPT act on conversations, contacts, calendars, and drafts via natural language ('Ask Claude to summarize your inbox and draft replies'), plus an in-app AI assistant that answers setup/config questions in natural language. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review of natural-language command accuracy/reliability and broader coverage beyond the documented MCP scopes.
